name: Pinwheel Tiling
recipe: Conway-Radin PINWHEEL aperiodic tiling: right triangles subdivided into 5 smaller copies recursively, producing a tiling whose tiles appear in INFINITELY MANY orientations (unlike Penrose) — a hypnotic non-periodic pinwheel of triangles at every angle. Slowly rotate + recolor + step subdivision depth on K.t. Default COLORFUL: triangles filled by orientation-hue with bright edges, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: recursively subdivide a right triangle to depth D (cache per depth/seed), each sub-triangle inherits a rotation; draw filled + edged triangles hued by their accumulated orientation angle; slow global rotation + hue drift on K.t, depth step on K.section. Fills frame.
style: orientation-hue (default, angle-colored facets). Also: stained-glass, blueprint (white edges on blue), gem, ink (named mono).

name: Ammann-Beenker
recipe: The Ammann-Beenker 8-FOLD aperiodic tiling: squares and 45-degree rhombi arranged with octagonal symmetry and the famous Ammann bar overlay lines — a quasicrystal distinct from Penrose's 5-fold. Slowly rotate + let a luminous highlight travel the Ammann bars on K.t. Default COLORFUL: rhombs/squares in two jewel hues with glowing Ammann-bar lines, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame, 8-fold symmetric.
kernel: generate the Ammann-Beenker tiling by the cut-and-project method (4D->2D) or square/rhomb inflation (cache in S); draw filled tiles + the Ammann bar overlay; traveling highlight + slow rotation on K.t. Fills frame.
style: quasi-octagon (default, two-hue tiles + glowing bars). Also: neon-lattice, stained-glass, blueprint, ink (named mono).

name: Firefly Synchrony
recipe: A swarm of fireflies that blink and SYNCHRONIZE: each firefly is an integrate-and-fire oscillator that nudges its neighbors' phase when it flashes, so from random twinkling the whole meadow spontaneously pulses in unison — emergent synchronization you can watch converge and break. Drifting through a dark meadow. Default COLORFUL: warm amber/green glowing firefly points on a deep night-blue gradient (with a faint grass silhouette), flashes blooming; luminance ~0.12-0.35, fills frame.
kernel: ~200-500 fireflies (pos drifting slowly, phase) in S; each frame advance phase, on fire (phase>1) flash (bright bloom) + nudge nearby fireflies' phase up (Mirollo-Strogatz coupling); draw glowing dots sized by flash brightness with additive bloom; coupling drifts on K.section (sync<->chaos). Blinking+drift = motion.
style: meadow (default, amber/green on night-blue). Also: cyan-swarm, ember, spectral, mono (named, white blinks).

name: Galton Board
recipe: A Galton board / bean machine: balls cascade down through a triangular array of pegs, bouncing left/right, and pile up at the bottom into a growing bell-curve histogram — probability made visible. Continuous stream of balls; the histogram builds, then resets and refills. Default COLORFUL: glowing balls (hue by column) bouncing down a dark board of pegs, the histogram bars lit by height; luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: peg lattice + falling ball particles in S; each frame step balls down (gravity + random left/right deflection at each peg row), accrete into a bottom histogram (bin counts -> bars); emit new balls at top; reset on K.section. Draw pegs faint, balls glowing, bars by count. Falling+building = motion.
style: neon-beans (default, column-hued balls + lit bars). Also: gold-on-black, thermal, phosphor, blueprint (named mono).

name: Flow Calligraphy
recipe: Generative ink calligraphy: variable-width brush strokes follow a flow field, swelling and tapering like sumi-e / gestural brushwork, laying down flowing glyph-like marks that accumulate into an abstract calligraphic composition, then the ink washes away and new strokes are written. Default COLORFUL: rich ink strokes (sumi black OR jewel-hued) with pressure-varied width + wet bleed on a warm paper or dark ground; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame, strokes continuously drawn on K.t.
kernel: spawn brush agents that integrate along a slow noise flow field, drawing tapered variable-width strokes (width = speed/pressure envelope) into a buffer with slight bleed; strokes fade slowly + new ones spawn continuously on K.t; hue/ink per stroke. Continuous writing = motion.
style: sumi (default, black ink + bleed on warm paper). Also: jewel-ink (hued strokes on dark), gold-leaf, neon-brush, blueprint (white on blue).

name: Turing Horns
recipe: A reaction-diffusion in the SPOTS-to-STRIPES-to-LABYRINTH regime with anisotropy, growing the branching 'coral horn' / fingerprint-ridge / brain-coral morphology — distinct from gray_scott's default by its directional ridged growth. Feed/kill + anisotropy drift on K.section so ridges reorganize between fingerprint, maze, and horn regimes. Default COLORFUL: ridges through a warm coral/bone palette (or vivid), luminance ~0.25-0.5, edge-to-edge, perpetually reorganizing.
kernel: Gray-Scott-type RD with an anisotropic/directional diffusion term in S (<=160 wide) tuned to the labyrinth/stripe regime; feed/kill + anisotropy angle drift on K.t/section; map V->warm ridged palette LUT, upscale. Intrinsic reorganization = motion.
style: coral-horn (default, warm coral/bone ridges). Also: fingerprint (ink ridges on cream), thermal, brain-coral (pink/grey), bio (teal).

name: Strange Attractor Cloud
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is NEAR-BLACK (lum 0.03) and faint. Re-author as a BRIGHT, DENSE strange-attractor point-cloud (choose a lovely 2D map — Peter de Jong or Svensson or Bedhead) that GLOWS and fills a good part of the frame (lum 0.15-0.4). Accumulate 40-80k iterates/frame with bright additive splats, log-density tone-map through an iq palette; drift the coefficients on K.t so the silky filaments morph continuously. NOT a sparse dark scribble.
kernel: iterate a 2D attractor map (de Jong: x'=sin(a y)-cos(b x), y'=sin(c x)-cos(d y)) 40-80k/frame, splat bright into a coarse density buffer, log-map palette LUT, upscale; drift a,b,c,d slowly on K.t. Dense, bright, morphing.
style: silk (default, indigo->gold density). Also: plasma, ember, bioluminescent, pencil (named mono).

name: Black Hole Accretion
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is NEAR-BLACK (lum 0.05) — mostly empty. Re-author as a DRAMATIC gravitationally-lensed black hole: a BRIGHT swirling accretion disk (Doppler-beamed, one side brighter) around a black event-horizon shadow, with a glowing photon ring and lensed light arcs, on a starfield. Disk rotates + an orbiting hotspot travels around it on K.t (break the rotational symmetry so motion reads). Default COLORFUL: hot orange/white inner disk -> cooler red/violet outer, blue-shifted approaching side; luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel or layered draw: bright accretion disk (radial+angular gradient, Doppler brightness on one side) around a central dark shadow + photon ring; an orbiting hotspot + infalling streaks on K.t break symmetry; faint lensed starfield. Fill frame, keep bright.
style: interstellar (default, orange/white disk). Also: violet-quasar, blue-giant, xray (white/blue), mono (named).

name: Flow Field Streams
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is NEAR-BLACK (lum 0.03) and faint. Re-author as a BRIGHT, DENSE flow-field: thousands of particles streaming along an evolving Perlin flow field leaving luminous trails that FILL the frame with silky flowing bands (lum 0.15-0.4). The field rotates/evolves on K.t so the streams perpetually reorganize. Default COLORFUL: trails hued by flow angle or speed (spectral) with additive glow on dark; NOT a few faint threads.
kernel: 2000-4000 particles advected by curl/perlin flow field (evolving on K.t), drawn as additive trail streaks into a slow-fade buffer, hue by angle/speed; reseed a fraction each frame. Fill the frame, keep bright + flowing.
style: spectral-flow (default, angle-hued streams). Also: aurora, ember, ink-flow (indigo on pale), neon.

name: Living Constellations
recipe: FIX of a baseline asset that is NEAR-BLACK (lum 0.05) and FROZEN (motion 0.007). Re-author as a living star-map: a rich starfield with drifting stars that dynamically connect into constellation line-figures which form, glow, dissolve and re-form as the sky slowly rotates; twinkling + shooting stars. Fill the frame with stars (lum 0.12-0.35, brighter than the near-black original) and give continuous motion (slow rotation + twinkle + reforming lines). Default COLORFUL: white/blue stars + cyan/gold constellation lines on deep night-blue.
kernel: star array (pos, brightness) slowly rotating on K.t + twinkle; each frame connect near stars into a few constellation polylines that fade/reform on K.section; occasional shooting star; faint nebula tint so it's not pure black. Rotation+twinkle+reforming = motion.
style: night-sky (default, white/blue stars + cyan/gold lines). Also: zodiac-gold, aurora-sky, blueprint (white on blue), mono (named).

name: Harmonograph
recipe: POLISH of a version that is too FAINT/DARK (lum 0.07). Keep the elegant harmonograph (damped Lissajous pendulum curves) but make it BRIGHTER and RICHER: thicker two-pass additive glow, vivid multi-hue curves, 2-3 superimposed pendulums, and continuous coefficient drift on K.t so it never re-phases and perpetually re-draws (lum 0.15-0.4). Fill more of the frame. Default COLORFUL: glowing spectral pendulum roulettes on dark.
kernel: draw 2-3 damped-harmonograph parametric curves (x=sum A_i e^{-d_i t} sin(f_i t+p_i)) as dense polylines with wide dim ADD glow + bright core; frequencies/phases drift continuously on K.t (incommensurate) so it never closes/repeats; hue per pendulum. Brighter + fuller.
style: spectral-glow (default, multi-hue pendulums). Also: gold, neon, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Domain-Warp Plasma
recipe: POLISH of a version whose DEFAULT came out too DARK (lum 0.11) and low-motion (0.017). Keep the domain-warped fBm plasma but RAISE THE DEFAULT EXPOSURE so the nebula is luminous (lum 0.2-0.45) and increase the default flow/boil SPEED so it visibly churns (motion >0.03). Keep the 5 styles. Default COLORFUL: bright cosmic nebula through the iq cosine palette, clearly boiling.
kernel: per-pixel domain-warp fBm plasma (existing kernel) with a HIGHER default energy/exposure and a faster default K.t boil/drift rate so the opening frame is bright and clearly moving. Coarse buffer, upscale.
style: nebula (default, bright). Also: thermal, ink, iridescent, blueprint.
